scripts.build: npm run build-tokens && npm run sync-default-theme && npm run extract-tokens && npm run blurhashes && npm run bundle-static-assets && next build
scripts.netlify-init: npm run env && npm run netrc && npm run init
scripts.init: rimraf tmp && mkdir -p tmp/images && node scripts/prepareProject.js && npm run push-components && npm run generate-content-types
scripts.dereference-schemas: kickstartDS schema dereference --schema-paths node_modules/@kickstartds/design-system/dist/components components --layer-order cms schema
scripts.generate-props: kickstartDS schema types --components-path node_modules/@kickstartds/design-system/dist/components --schema-paths node_modules/@kickstartds/design-system/dist/components components --layer-order cms schema --merge-schemas false --type-naming id
scripts.create-defaults: kickstartDS schema defaults --schema-paths node_modules/@kickstartds/design-system/dist/components components --layer-order cms schema
scripts.storyblok-pull-content-schema: storyblok components pull -p types/ && mv types/components/$NEXT_STORYBLOK_SPACE_ID/components.json types/components-schema.json && mv types/components/$NEXT_STORYBLOK_SPACE_ID/groups.json types/components-groups.json && mv types/components/$NEXT_STORYBLOK_SPACE_ID/presets.json types/components-presets.json && rm -rf types/components/
scripts.generate-content-types: dotenvx run -f .env.local -- npm run pull-content-schema && storyblok-generate-ts source=./types/components-schema.json target=./types/components-schema compilerOptions.unknownAny=true compilerOptions.additionalProperties=false
scripts.push-components-dry-run: echo 'Dry-run: review cms/merge-report.json instead (CLI v4 dry-run not available as CLI flag)'
scripts.push-component: dotenvx run -f .env.local -- storyblok components push -p cms/merged/ --filter
scripts.rename-generated-config: mv cms/components.123456.json cms/components.generated.json && mv cms/presets.123456.json cms/presets.generated.json
scripts.update-storyblok-config: npm run create-storyblok-config && npm run rename-generated-config && npm run pull-content-schema && npm run merge-storyblok-config && npm run push-components
scripts.create-storyblok-config: node scripts/seedCmsConfig.js && kickstartDS cms storyblok --schema-paths node_modules/@kickstartds/design-system/dist/components components --layer-order cms schema --configuration-path cms --templates page blog-post blog-overview settings event-detail event-list search token-theme --components blog-teaser business-card contact content-nav cta divider downloads event-latest-teaser event-list-teaser faq features gallery headline hero html image-story image-text info-table logos mosaic prompter section slider split-even split-weighted stats teaser-card testimonials text video-curtain && node scripts/generatePresets.js
scripts.update-storyblok-config-reset: npm run create-storyblok-config && npm run rename-generated-config && npm run pull-content-schema && npm run merge-storyblok-config-reset && npm run push-components
